title: End-to-End Variational Networks for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction
layout_note: Overview row across the top: input multi-coil k-space at the left, a cascade drawn as two parallel branches (DC above, R below) summed at a circled plus and repeated with ellipses, then output k-space, IFT to coil images, and RSS/crop to the final image. Below it three detail panels stack top to bottom (Data Consistency, Refinement, Sensitivity Map Estimation), each a tinted box with its inputs drawn outside on the left and its output outside on the right.
grouping: Each module has one pastel tint used both for its small box in the overview and for the background of its detail panel: pale green for DC, pale peach for R, pale blue for SME. Detail panels are square-cornered tinted rectangles titled in bold above (Data Consistency (DC), Refinement (R), Sensitivity Map Estimation (SME)); the overview itself has no container.
shapes_depth: Flat square boxes with thin dark outlines; operators are small circles (+, -, *). Every data tensor is a real image: multi-coil k-space and coil images are drawn as decks of slightly offset stacked slices, the k-space showing vertical undersampling lines with a bright centre, sensitivity maps as smooth grey blobs, the ACS-masked k-space with the outer region blacked out. Thin black arrows with operation names written on them (IFT, Reduce, U-Net, Expand, FT, ACS Mask, Divide by RSS).
proposed_highlight: No colour marks novelty; the three module letters (DC, R, SME) in the overview are tied to their expanded panels by matching tints and bold panel titles, and the panels carry the content.
lesson: Operations are written on the arrows (IFT, Reduce, U-Net, Expand, FT) between real image stacks, so a module's detail panel reads as a chain of data states — k-space, coil images, combined image — rather than a chain of boxes.
notes: venue unverified: remembered as MICCAI 2020, but neither the PDF first page nor arXiv metadata (no journal_ref or comment) confirms it; year = arXiv preprint year. Images are embedded rasters; labels are italic sans for data names and bold sans for panel titles.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
